_comment: M42/T42.5 (R18-F2, docs/plan-drive-identity.md §2.4): what scripts/drive/run.py must discover under widgets/ before it opens any window.
Edited by hand, never generated from the inventories: a manifest read from what it checks is the tautology this replaces.
A removal fails; an addition fails until this file names it, so the change is visible in the diff.
`static` lists every action that is not checked for landing; `counts` pins actions, landed-checked (non-static) and isolated (T42.6).
M44/T44.10 added Select and ScrollView (owed since M42) and a keyboard action each to PickList, ColorPicker, Tree (two) and DataGrid.
M45/T45.6 added word-Left, double click and triple click to TextInput and TextArea, and Ctrl+End and Home to TextArea.
The M56 merge made NumberInput's letter refusal static: its landing had been read off the click inside `do`, never off the letters.
M80/T80.2 added Label: its demo's switch sets a 1.5x line height through the program's style_by, and a second press restores it.
M80/T80.3 added Label's ellipsis switch: one press cuts the paragraph to one line (the whole text still published), a second wraps it again.
M80/T80.4 added Selectable: a drag across the first line, then app.copy (copied and clipboard equal); a double click copies one word. A press outside clears it (both isolates).

M81/T81.6 added TextInput RTL (`שלום world 123`, driven by the +shaping legs): a click at the visual left end, then a character, appends at the logical end; a press above it types nowhere (the isolate).
M82/T82.3 added Card's static fill check: its centre and side pixels differ by at least 16 levels (a radial, by role) and its corner pixel is the stage behind it (rounded).
M82/T82.5 added PaintBox's static path check: the star the callback fills with Painter::path covers at least 90% of its analytic outline in its colour, and none of that colour is outside the box.

M82/T82.8 added VectorText's two static checks: the 90° run's ink, read from the screenshot, is at least twice as tall as wide with none outside its box, and the node publishes "Vertical" as its value, which ~=Vertical resolves to.

M84/T84.3 added Image: a second of playing presents 10 ± 1 frames at 1.00x the image's box and moves its pixels (paused, the same wait presents 0); a press pauses and holds the frame, a second resumes; and K84c's static check, the median layout per animated frame against 100 µs.

M84/T84.8 added Video: play changes the picture within 250 ms; pause flips the button to Play and holds the picture over 500 ms; a press at 75% of the track hands on_seek 0.75 and shows frame 3 at 300 ms; a drag 25% -> 50% while playing ends at 50% with no frame from a stopped feed; and the static check that a press on the picture is not handled and changes nothing.
M85/T85.1 added Layout: a static geometry check that a flexible(1) bar with 80 px of content is min(80, row/2) wide beside a fill that takes the rest, on one line.

M85/T85.2 added Pin: a static check that the pinned button sits at the pin's origin plus (112, 64), inside the pin; and a click on it moves the press counter by one with the damage over the pin at 1.00x the button's own box.

M85/T85.4 added Pop: a static check that the placeholder starts below the fold of a view shorter than the window, both heights printed; and PageDown until it is in view makes the application say loaded, with the loading frame's damage over the view at 1.00x the placeholder's box.

M87/T87.2 added Markdown's static quote check: in both palettes the demo's least contrasting run is a quote word, at AA or better, and its colour differs between the two (the quote colour follows the palette).
M87/T87.3 added LinkedMarkdown: a click on the `~=changelog` Link child runs the handler with that link, and the readout names its target; a press on the plain first word runs nothing (the isolate).

M87/T87.4 added LinkedMarkdown's static image check: the demo's `![..](spin)` is one Image child inside the paragraph, labelled with its alt text, and at least 5% of its box is off the page fill in the screenshot.

M90/T90.2 added `secondary`: every action whose `do` sends a left input.click, filed by the secondary-button leg as `checked` (the same click with button right answered handled false and left the widget's pixels unchanged) or `overlay_open` (not sent: a popup was open, and a right press outside an open one dismisses it, gated headlessly in crates/lumen-static/tests/context_request.rs).

M90/T90.4 added ContextMenu (scripts/drive/widgets/menus.py), and the secondary leg's `opened` list: an action of an entry `secondary.context` names whose replayed right click lands inside the widget must open its context menu (handled true, one overlay) and Escape must restore its pixels.
